3: For the music director. A psalm of David. When Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba. Be gracious to me, O God, according to your loyal love. According to your abundant mercies, blot out my transgressions.
4: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity, and from my sin cleanse me.
5: For ⌞I myself know⌟ my transgressions, and my sin is ever before me.
6: Against you, only you, I have sinned and have done this evil in your eyes, so that you are correct when you speak, you are blameless when you judge.
7: Behold, in iniquity I was born, and in sin my mother conceived me.
8: Behold, you delight in truth in the inward parts, and in the hidden parts you make me to know wisdom.
9: Purify me with hyssop, and I shall be clean. Wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
10: Make me hear joy and gladness; let the bones you have crushed rejoice.
11: Hide your face from my sins, and all my iniquities blot out.
12: Create a clean heart for me, O God, and renew a steadfast spirit ⌞within me⌟.
13: Do not cast me away from your presence, and do not take your Holy Spirit from me.
14: Restore to me the joy of your salvation, and with a willing spirit sustain me.
15: Then I will teach transgressors your ways, and sinners will turn back to you.
16: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation; then my tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness.
17: O Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will proclaim your praise.
18: For you do not delight in sacrifice or I would give it. With a burnt offering you are not pleased.
19: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; A broken and contrite heart, O God, you will not despise.
20: Do good in your favor toward Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem.
21: Then you will delight in righteous sacrifices, burnt offering and whole burnt offering. Then bulls will be offered on your altar.
